ID: `jado-agent-ux`.

## What it does

Applies the assigned skills in the same context: jado-researcher, jado-ux-architect, jado-content-designer. The contract may select just one or combine several.

## When to use it

When an assignment within its domain is needed: several activities in the same instance in macro, or a bounded assignment in a new instance in specialists.

## How to use it

Provide the contract, assigned activities, order, scope and required evidence. Use role procedures without starting other agents.

## What it delivers

- Assigned outcomes with revision, evidence and limitations

## Example

Assign jado-researcher to jado-agent-ux for the requested outcome, with explicit sources, scope and budget.

## Prerequisites

- Readable JADO root and tools required by the assigned procedures.

## Executable instructions

[Open the JADO procedure](https://github.com/mattiamichini-design/jado/blob/HEAD/.agents/skills/jado-ux/SKILL.md)
